Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.rmi.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualViewRmi, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServer, VirtualViewRmi
Implements both the VirtualServer interface so the client is able to create an instance of this class to send requests but implements also VirtualViewRmi so the RMI server is able to send response messages to this callback stub.
Requests are sent on a single daemon thread so server communication is not blocking for the server and for the client main threads. It is important to set the java.rmi.server.hostname system variable before creating and starting this object. Otherwise, super(port) could export a wrong ip interface to the server, making impossible for it to send responses.

      public RmiClient(String ip, int port, MessageDispatcher messageDispatcher) throws RemoteException, NotBoundException
      Creates an instance of RMIClient. WARNING: It is important to set the java.rmi.server.hostname system variable before creating and starting this object.
      Parameters:
      ip - the server ip
      port - the RMIServer port
      messageDispatcher - the object that will route the messages
      Throws:
